factories.name: newSearchTicketsStep
factories.description: List one page of tickets, most recently updated first, for a customer email or ID and an optional Gorgias view, keeping only the requested statuses, priorities, tags, and update time, with a cursor for the next page.

inputSchema.description: SearchTicketsInput lists tickets most recently updated first. RequesterEmail, RequesterID, and ViewID narrow the list on Gorgias's side; Statuses, Priorities, Tags, and UpdatedSince filter each page after Gorgias returns it, so a page can hold fewer than PageSize tickets, even none, while NextCursor is set. Several statuses, priorities, or tags match any of them.

cursor.description: Cursor is a previous page's NextCursor, read with the same filters.

pageSize.description: PageSize is 1 to MaxSearchPageSize tickets listed from Gorgias; zero uses DefaultSearchPageSize.

priorities.description: Priorities keeps tickets with any of these Gorgias priorities. Empty keeps every priority.

requesterEmail.description: RequesterEmail lists only the tickets of the customer whose primary email address this is, such as jane@example.com. A customer that does not exist yields an empty page.

requesterId.description: RequesterID lists only the tickets of this Gorgias customer. Use it or RequesterEmail, not both.

statuses.description: Statuses keeps tickets in any of these Gorgias statuses. Empty keeps every status.

tags.description: Tags keeps tickets carrying any of these tag names, compared case sensitively as Gorgias does.

updatedSince.description: UpdatedSince keeps tickets updated at or after this RFC 3339 instant with an explicit offset, such as 2026-01-21T00:00:00Z. Without ViewID it also ends paging at the first older ticket.

viewId.description: ViewID lists only the tickets matching the filters of this Gorgias view, such as one an administrator built for a status and tag; Gorgias then orders the page by the view's sort.

factories.name: newGetTicketStep
factories.description: Read one ticket by ID with its customer and a bounded list of its latest messages, internal notes included.

inputSchema.description: GetTicketInput names one ticket and how many of its latest messages to return.

latestMessageLimit.description: LatestMessageLimit is 1 to MaxLatestMessageLimit; zero uses DefaultLatestMessageLimit.

ticketId.description: TicketID is the Gorgias ticket ID.

factories.name: newFindCustomerByEmailStep
factories.description: Find the Gorgias customer whose primary email address is the given address.

inputSchema.description: FindCustomerByEmailInput names the email address to look up.

email.description: Email is one bare address, such as jane@example.com.

factories.name: newCreateTicketStep
factories.description: Create one ticket with the customer's first message. Gorgias has no idempotency key, so the Step runs with sync durability, records a Dex checkpoint before sending, and finds an unconfirmed ticket by the external ID it wrote instead of sending again. A Worker lost before Dex stores the checkpoint can still send twice when the first ticket is not yet visible.

TicketRequesterInput.description: TicketRequesterInput identifies the requester by email. Gorgias uses the customer with that primary address or, when none exists, adds a customer named Name.

email.description: Email is one bare address such as jane@example.com.

name.description: Name names a customer Gorgias adds; blank lets Gorgias derive one.

inputSchema.description: CreateTicketInput is one new ticket and the customer's first message. Zero values leave a field to Gorgias's defaults and the account's rules.

assigneeTeamId.description: AssigneeTeamID assigns the ticket to a Gorgias team, or zero for none.

assigneeUserId.description: AssigneeUserID assigns the ticket to a Gorgias user, or zero for none.

description.description: Description is the customer's first message as plain text. It is required. The connector also sends it HTML-escaped as body_html, so markup is shown literally and line breaks are kept.

priority.description: Priority is a Gorgias priority, or empty for Gorgias's default, normal.

requester.description: Requester is the customer asking for help. It is required.

status.description: Status is open or closed, or empty for Gorgias's default, open.

subject.description: Subject is the ticket subject, at most MaxSubjectLength characters. It is required.

tags.description: Tags are tag names set on the new ticket; Gorgias creates unknown names and rules may add more.

factories.name: newUpdateTicketStep
factories.description: Set the status, priority, assigned user, or assigned team of one ticket and add or remove tags; a repeated attempt finds the change already applied and writes nothing.

inputSchema.description: UpdateTicketInput is one change to an existing ticket. Empty and zero fields are left unchanged; this release cannot unassign a user or team.

addTags.description: AddTags adds these tag names and keeps the ticket's other tags. Names compare case sensitively.

assigneeTeamId.description: AssigneeTeamID assigns a Gorgias team, or zero to keep the team.

assigneeUserId.description: AssigneeUserID assigns a Gorgias user, or zero to keep the assignee.

priority.description: Priority is the new Gorgias priority, or empty to keep it.

removeTags.description: RemoveTags removes these tag names and keeps the ticket's other tags.

status.description: Status is open or closed, or empty to keep it.

ticketId.description: TicketID is the Gorgias ticket ID.

factories.name: newAddNoteStep
factories.description: Add one internal note or one public email reply to a ticket. Gorgias has no idempotency key, so the Step runs with sync durability, records a Dex checkpoint before sending, and finds an unconfirmed message by the external ID it wrote instead of sending again. A Worker lost before Dex stores the checkpoint can still send twice when the first message is not yet visible.

inputSchema.description: AddNoteInput is one internal note or one public email reply to add to a ticket.

body.description: Body is the plain-text note or reply. It is required. The connector also sends it HTML-escaped as body_html, so markup is shown literally and line breaks are kept.

isPublicReply.description: IsPublicReply sends the body as an email that Gorgias delivers to the customer, to the sender of the customer's newest email on the ticket, through the integration that received it. The reply comes from the address an earlier agent email through that integration came from, or else from that email's only To or CC address other than the customer's; when neither identifies the helpdesk address, nothing is sent and providerRejected is selected. False adds an internal note that only agents see.

ticketId.description: TicketID is the Gorgias ticket ID.
